name: Knowledge routing for resilience, forgiveness, and purpose
description: Verifies the engine routes resilience, forgiveness, and purpose queries to the knowledge shelf (priority 55) and returns a relevant reply rather than a generic fallback.

turns.text: I'm trying to be more resilient these days. Life has been throwing a lot at me.
I also struggle with forgiveness. It is hard to let go of old hurts.
Sometimes I wonder what the meaning of life really is. I feel lost.
What do the stoics say about resilience and strength?
I want to find my purpose, but I don't know where to start.
